description: Razor (split) all clips at the playhead position across all tracks, or at a specific time. A read-only preflight counts eligible track cuts; the host wait scales by that count (400 ms per cut plus 30 seconds headroom, capped at 15 minutes).

time_seconds.description: Time to razor at in seconds (uses playhead position if omitted)

track_type.description: Which track types to razor (default: both)

name: razor_all_tracks

data.description: Tool-specific result data when ok is true; on failure, diagnostic detail when the tool provides it.

error.description: Failure detail when ok is false.

title: Razor All Tracks
